pages.text: TYPE_HASH stands for the type HASH: values stored under text keys.$(br2)A hash grows and shrinks by itself. After HASH comes the type of its content, like $(1)HASH INTEGER$(). A new key adds a new element.
Craft a type base and a chest. A trapped chest works too.
$(1)VARIABLE stock HASH INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  gold 10$(br)END VARIABLE$(br)ASSIGN stock["diamond"] 3 ;$()
